splash.title: Glukhoman
splash.description: Restaurant, hotel, water park, and wood-fired sauna - four vacation destinations in one place. Choose your evening.

restaurant.title: Restaurant "Glukhoman"
restaurant.description: A two-storey restaurant in an old fairy-tale style, a covered terrace and three summer areas on the water. Ukrainian wood-fired oven, craft beer and live music on weekends.

hotel.title: Hotel "Glukhoman"
hotel.description: Cozy rooms on the territory of the complex overlooking the pond, swans and fountains. A restaurant, water park and wood-fired sauna are nearby.

sauna.title: Wood-fired sauna
sauna.description: Wood-burning vats with Carpathian herbs, steam room, oak and bamboo brooms, massages and relaxation rooms with samovars.

aquapark.title: Water park "Glukhoman"
aquapark.description: Outdoor water park with water slides, heated pools and a separate children's area. Open during the summer season.

story.prose: In the village of Nyzhni Mlyny, amidst a willow grove and a quiet pond with swans, a whole world has been built for those who are tired of the city. A two-story restaurant in an old fairy-tale style, a hotel in the middle of nature, a wood-fired bathhouse with Carpathian herbs, and an outdoor water park are all in one place.
story.pull_quote: "Three summer playgrounds on the water, surrounded by fountains and swans - this is where real relaxation begins."

features.headline: Glukhoman
features.intro: From its own brewery and live music to wood-fired vats, peacocks in an aviary, and a pond with swans, here are ten reasons to stay longer.
features.f01_description: Vaulted ceilings, candlelight, and a long table for weddings, anniversaries, and special occasions.
features.f02_description: Authentic dishes from live fire according to old recipes.
features.f03_description: Friday, Saturday, Sunday - acoustic sets in the main hall of the restaurant.
features.f04_description: Baths with infusions of Carpathian herbs under the starry sky - for two.
features.f05_description: Own production - tastings and excursions for guests.
features.f06_description: A maze, laser tag, a soap show, and a spacious game room.
features.f07_description: A separate room with a live aviary - lunch in the company of fairy birds.
features.f08_description: Pools, slides and a recreation area in the warm season.
features.f09_description: Three summer playgrounds on the water, surrounded by fountains and swans.
features.f10_description: VIP-hall with a 12-foot table and unfiltered beer of own production.

services.intro_body: Hotel, restaurant, water park and bathhouse on the same territory. Come for lunch, stay for a weekend, celebrate a wedding or anniversary for up to 150 guests.

hotel.title: Hotel
hotel.tagline: Wake up to birdsong 20 meters from the pond.
hotel.description: Wooden rooms on the territory of the complex - from standard to family cottages. A step to the restaurant, water park and bathhouse, the silence of the pine forest and private parking near the building.
hotel.h2: Pond, swans, fountains under the window
hotel.h3: Breakfast in the restaurant of the complex

aquapark.title: Water park
aquapark.tagline: The whole summer is spent in heated pools and under slides.
aquapark.description: Outdoor water park with water slides, adult pools and a separate children's area. Sunbeds, a water bar, changing rooms and a safe bottom. Open during the warm season.

restaurant.title: Restaurant
restaurant.tagline: Dishes from the Ukrainian wood-fired oven and peacocks in the hall.
restaurant.description: Two floors, a large summer terrace, a Ukrainian wood-fired oven and craft beer of our own production. Zhar-Ptytsia hall with a pavilionarium, live music on weekends and banquets for up to 150 guests.
restaurant.h2: Craft beer of our own production

sauna.tagline: Vats of Carpathian herbs under the starry sky.
sauna.description: Wood-burning vats with Carpathian herbs, a steam room with oak and bamboo brooms, a relaxation room with a samovar and a cold font. gLOSSARY_2__ Ukrainian tradition in a modern setting.

location.headline_p1: On the edge of the village,
location.body: Poltava region, p. Nyzhni Mlyny. About 15 minutes from Poltava, and you can already hear the sound of the forest and the cry of wild ducks over the water.

reviews.r1_text: We came back for the third time. Hotel, restaurant, water park - everything is on the same level. Special thanks to the chef for the duck with apples and the staff who remembered us from our last visit.
reviews.r2_text: We celebrated our wedding anniversary. The suite overlooking the pond, dinner on the terrace, and a wood-fired sauna were unforgettable. We came here from Kharkiv and didn't regret a second of it.
reviews.r3_text: We held a corporate event for 40 people. The banquet hall, animation, brewery with tasting - everything was done without a single hitch. The team was perfectly organized.
reviews.r4_text: We came with our children (3 and 7 years old) for the winter vacation. The water park was open, the restaurant had a children's menu, and the hotel had a warm family room. The kids are delighted, we had a great time.
reviews.r5_text: The wood-fired bath with Carpathian herbs is a separate song. I have not had such a deep rest for a long time. The tea room with a samovar is a highlight. We will definitely come back again.

booking_cta.tagline: On the edge of the village, over a pond with swans and fountains, this is where your real vacation begins.
booking_cta.body: A hotel room, a table in a restaurant, a wood-fired vat, a banquet for 90 guests or a family weekend - leave a request or call us and we'll take care of the rest.
